thesis: The episode defines NFTs as non-fungible tokens that act as blockchain-based records uniquely representing digital or physical assets, thereby enabling ownership and provenance tracking without reliance on third-party intermediaries. It further argues that the underlying crypto infrastructure allows for instantaneous global trade, permissionless issuance, and the ability to use these assets as collateral.
